predecessors.name: Twenty-first Dynasty of Egypt
predecessors.text: the Delta around Tanis; infobox 'Preceded by Twenty-first Dynasty of Egypt'

successors.name: Twenty-third Dynasty of Egypt
successors.text: Upper Egypt with Thebes and Herakleopolis, from 837 (Twenty-third Dynasty infobox)

successors.name: Twenty-fourth Dynasty of Egypt
successors.text: Tefnakht's Sais and the western Delta, c.

successors.name: Kingdom of Kush
successors.text: the Delta remnant of Osorkon IV, 'Piye ... seized control of Lower Egypt around 727 BC'

ledger.x: 943: Shoshenq I founds the Twenty-second Dynasty.
943: Middle and Upper Egypt pass from the Theban priests' orbit to Shoshenq I (assumed).
ledger.cpn: High Priests of Amun at Thebes

ledger.x: 837: the Twenty-third Dynasty is established in the south.
826: civil war breaks out over Thebes.

c. 732: Tefnakht of Sais breaks away. 'Sais (c. 732-720 BC, Twenty-fourth Dynasty of Egypt)' in the infobox; 'the combined forces of several native Egyptian rulers' including 'Tefnakht of Sais' faced Piye c. 732. Osorkon IV (730-716) 'only controlled a small portion of Lower Egypt' (22nd Dynasty page).
728: Piye of Kush campaigns in Egypt.
716: the last campaign year of the Victory Stela (728-716).

wars.name: Theban civil war of Takelot II
wars.outcome: Settled in Year 39 of Shoshenq III; the Twenty-third Dynasty keeps Upper Egypt with Thebes (Osorkon III 798-769).

wars.name: Piye's conquest of Egypt
wars.outcome: Kushite victory: the native rulers (Tefnakht of Sais, Osorkon IV and others) are defeated; the Twenty-fifth Dynasty follows.

certainty.note: No frontier of the Libyan-age kingdoms is described by the pages opened; the Delta/Upper Egypt line is approximate throughout.
